fact: The Fonds Social states that the STEP 2 project, with about 300,000 direct cash-transfer and cash-for-work beneficiaries, has no management information system yet and recruits a database specialist to design and develop an integrated beneficiary management system with mobile payment interoperability.
title: Spécialiste en base de données et registres sociaux
publisher: Fonds Social de la RDC (via NGO Tenders)
